title: Multi-Group Proportional Representation for Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating gender representation in generated images compared to reference datasets (e.g., FairFace) or historical statistics using the Multi-Group Proportional Representation (MPR) metric and automated gender classifiers.
Measuring the maximum deviation in the representation of different age groups (e.g., young vs. old) in generated images for various prompts using the MPR metric and age classifiers.
Assessing representational disparities across multiple racial groups in images generated from various profession and trait prompts using the MPR metric and race classifiers.

Quantifying the overrepresentation of specific disabilities (e.g., wheelchair users) and their intersectional racial skew using the MPR metric, utilizing BLIP2 Visual Question Answering (VQA) to detect wheelchair presence.

Using the MPR framework with binary decision trees to measure the worst-case deviation of representation statistics across complex combinations of multiple demographic identities (gender, age, and race).
